pending.title: Bacterial Genomic DNA Isolation for Sequencing

pending.title: DNase I Footprinting
pending.summary: Map where a DNA-binding protein, such as an E. coli transcription factor, sits on a 100–400 bp fragment: 32P end-label a PCR probe, bind the protein, digest lightly with DNase I, and read the protected ladder on a denaturing gel against a G+A sequence ladder, with optional affinity estimates from a titration.
